request: Implement last query time, program version and error guidance; put frequently used functions above secondary features.

metadata.visibleTime: Last adopted known-mode result receipt in the GUI, local time with UTC offset.

validation.testDefinition: Registered cases; internal status/source iterations not counted separately.
validation.buildMethod: Existing SDK/package cache; both builds used --no-restore, no dependency installation or network restore.

independentSourceAudit.scope: Independent read-only source/XAML/test/packager review; no product edits, builds, tests, Windows execution, OEM calls, helper execution, network calls, or artifact validation by this reviewer.

sourceBoundary.newApplicationRelease: Pure compile-time Version, FileVersion and DisplayText string constants; Core binary may change as a result.

xaml.limitations: Keyboard focus, clipping, DPI and screen-reader behavior reviewed statically; new Windows runtime not exercised.
xaml.bindingCountNote: 78 named binding expressions plus 1 pathless header-template {Binding} equals 79 Binding-valued XML attributes.

viewModel.receiptTimeMeaning: Cached GUI result receipt for the adopted known-mode request, not exact firmware query time or continuous current-state guarantee.
viewModel.lateEpochResult: May remain a detached historical report; cannot restore live mode or visible receipt.
viewModel.historicalReportTimes: Request start and result recorded times captured in UTC once, never overwritten at save/retry.
viewModel.deduplication: Immutable per-request report object, saved once after success; save failure permits retry without helper replay.
viewModel.clockFailure: Missing metadata remains unobserved without changing device outcome.
viewModel.pendingGuidance: Shared primary guidance preserves blocking and no force-close/relaunch instructions on result, invalidation, stale completion, Mock refusal and close refusal.

coverage: no getter/poll clock or helper work
cached local receipt and UTC export metadata
failed/pending results stay unknown and blocked

checks: same helper/shared build bytes between app and helper build folders
nine-entry allowlist, CRC and byte comparison

independentPackageAudit.scope: Static inspection only; no product/helper execution, builds, tests, OEM queries, or network calls by reviewer. Audit JSON uses repository-relative paths and file basenames.
limitations: Windows runtime, UAC/helper IPC, actual device control, keyboard focus, DPI/clipping and screen reader behavior were not exercised for this release.
Receipt/report metadata describe GUI events and are not exact firmware query timestamps or continuous current state.

runtimeBoundary.nextUserCheck: Open normally from one ZIP in a new folder; inspect primary order, release version, cached result receipt time and access to collapsed features. No charging test repetition required.
